fields.description: Golf Dale combines one- to three-bedroom apartments with a small collection of three-bedroom townhouses at Emaar South. The townhouses sit along the podium, facing the golf course, while apartment layouts vary by tower and floor. Warm colours and natural materials connect the interiors with the surrounding landscape.

overview: Outdoor recreation is central to Golf Dale’s plan: pools and barbecue spaces sit alongside exercise routes and a yoga deck. The brochure also describes the wider community’s golf clubhouse, retail plaza, play areas and activity spaces. Golf access and wider-community facilities require separate confirmation of opening dates, membership and any charges.
research.locationNote: Golf Dale is within Emaar South in Dubai South. The developer places Golf Views, Golf Point and Urbana III nearby. Views differ by home; check the actual tower, floor and orientation rather than assuming every apartment has the same golf outlook.
research.priceNote: Emaar displays prices from AED 2,701,888 for its advertised selection, while its key facts retain an older AED 1.12m starting figure. The launch sheet lists one-bedroom apartments from AED 1.12m, two-bedroom from AED 1.61m, three-bedroom from AED 2.47m and townhouses from AED 4m. Property Finder labels the project sold out. A dated developer quotation is needed to establish current stock and terms.
research.paymentNote: The launch PDF specifies 10% at booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Property Finder lists this structure alongside another payment option; that alternative has not been established in the checked developer document. The dated schedule below is historical launch information.
research.handoverNote: The payment document estimates December 2028 completion, consistent with Property Finder’s Q4 2028 date. This is an estimate, not confirmation of a guaranteed handover date.

facts.label: Published unit mix
facts.value: The launch sheet totals 200 homes: 70 one-bedroom, 106 two-bedroom and 19 three-bedroom apartments, plus five three-bedroom townhouses. This is development capacity, not available stock.

facts.label: Townhouse Type 1
facts.value: A two-level layout with a ground-floor bedroom, maid’s room and bathroom, laundry and a garden-access terrace. Upstairs are two bedrooms, a store and a main-suite walk-in wardrobe and balcony.

facts.label: Compare inside and outside space
facts.value: Townhouse TH02/TH04 totals 2,541.57 sq ft, comprising 2,017.80 sq ft suite and 523.77 sq ft balcony allocation. Published totals include outdoor areas; they do not establish plot size.

unresolved: Tower 2 three-bedroom Type 3A has an area-table inconsistency: printed suite plus balcony is one square foot below its printed total. Obtain the selected unit’s certified area schedule.
Current availability, service charges, parking allocation, final finishes, construction progress and contractual handover need confirmation.
Images remain illustrative; real project photography is deferred.
